title: Dreamtime at the G 2025
metaDescription: Dreamtime at the G is the annual AFL fixture between Essendon and Richmond at the Melbourne Cricket Ground.

overview.about: Dreamtime at the 'G is the AFL's flagship Indigenous Round fixture, an Essendon-Richmond clash at the MCG that celebrates the contribution of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander players to the game. It features a pre-match Welcome to Country and the Long Walk tradition.
overview.nextEvent: The next Dreamtime at the 'G is played at the MCG as the centrepiece of the AFL's Sir Doug Nicholls Indigenous Round. Essendon and Richmond meet in a fixture that blends football with a celebration of Indigenous culture.
